items.title: Tyson Q4 earnings: Beef business could return to profit in 2027
items.summary: Al Root, Barron's Associate Editor, joins the 8:30 hosts, Julie Hyman and Pras Subramanian, to discuss Tyson Foods (TSN) issuing new guidance that its beef business could return to profitability in fiscal 2027, after losses tied to several factors, including record-high beef prices.
